questions.explanation: 前文提到母亲不理解作者为什么喜欢五金店，后文给出原因：她从未去过。因此母亲不能理解这件事并不令人‘惊讶’（surprising）。
questions.supplement:
A(satisfying)：语境句：The team achieved a satisfying result in the final match. 固定搭配：satisfying experience, deeply satisfying
B(annoying)：语境句：It is annoying when people talk loudly in the library. 固定搭配：annoying habit, find sth annoying
C(interesting)：语境句：It is interesting to explore different cultures. 固定搭配：find sth interesting, an interesting perspective
D(surprising)：语境句：It is not surprising that he passed the exam with flying colors. 固定搭配：hardly surprising, not surprising

questions.explanation: 此处与母亲形成对比，且后文全篇在讲述父亲带自己逛五金店的经历，以及老板提到‘Fathers come in with their kids...’，说明五金店是一件‘爸爸们的事’（dad thing）。
questions.supplement:
A(dad thing)：语境句：Fixing the broken pipe is totally a dad thing in our house. 固定搭配：do a dad thing, typical dad thing
B(child game)：语境句：Solving this complex puzzle is no child game. 固定搭配：play a child game
C(rare experience)：语境句：Seeing a shooting star is a rare experience for city residents. 固定搭配：a rare experience, offer a rare experience
D(family place)：语境句：This restaurant is a great family place with a children's menu. 固定搭配：family place, friendly family place

questions.explanation: 父亲在五金店的过道里闲逛、漫步。wander指‘漫步，闲逛’，符合在商店里边走边看寻找物品的动作状态。stood(站立)，sat(坐)，worked(工作)均不符合购物情境。
questions.supplement:
A(stood)：语境句：He stood perfectly still while the photographer took the picture. 固定搭配：stand still, stand for
B(wandered)：语境句：We wandered around the old town for a few hours. 固定搭配：wander around, wander aimlessly
C(sat)：语境句：She sat silently in the corner of the room. 固定搭配：sit down, sit around
D(worked)：语境句：He worked tirelessly to complete the project on time. 固定搭配：work out, work on

questions.explanation: 搭配with复合结构。tail作动词意为‘尾随，紧跟’，此处指作者小时候紧紧跟在父亲身后走在过道里。assist(帮助)，advise(建议)，pull(拉)均不符合小孩子在商店里跟着大人的情形。
questions.supplement:
A(assisting)：语境句：She is assisting the manager with the daily operations. 固定搭配：assist sb with/in sth
B(advising)：语境句：The lawyer is advising his client on legal matters. 固定搭配：advise sb to do sth, advise on
C(tailing)：语境句：The detective was tailing the suspect closely. 固定搭配：tail sb, put a tail on sb
D(pulling)：语境句：The little boy was pulling his toy car across the room. 固定搭配：pull out, pull over

questions.explanation: 父亲一边找东西一边不冷落孩子，这是一种增进父子感情的互动。bonding意为‘建立亲密关系’，符合父子在一起度过美好时光的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(relaxing)：语境句：Listening to light music is a relaxing experience. 固定搭配：find sth relaxing, a relaxing atmosphere
B(shopping)：语境句：She usually goes shopping on weekends. 固定搭配：go shopping, do the shopping
C(socializing)：语境句：The party provides a good opportunity for socializing. 固定搭配：socialize with sb
D(bonding)：语境句：The camping trip was a great bonding experience for the team. 固定搭配：family bonding, team bonding

questions.explanation: 父亲不时停下来指给‘我’看一些园艺工具，因为他觉得这些工具可能会‘给‘我’留下深刻印象’或‘吸引‘我’’（impress）。下文提到‘我’觉得有的工具像科幻电影里的机械臂，正印证了这种吸引力。
questions.supplement:
A(impress)：语境句：His excellent presentation skills never fail to impress the audience. 固定搭配：impress sb with sth, leave a deep impression on
B(refresh)：语境句：A cold shower will refresh you after a long journey. 固定搭配：refresh one's memory, refresh oneself
C(instruct)：语境句：The coach will instruct the players on the new strategy. 固定搭配：instruct sb to do sth, instruct sb in sth
D(shape)：语境句：Education helps to shape a child's character. 固定搭配：shape the future, shape up

questions.explanation: 后文的‘docent’（博物馆等机构的讲解员）是强烈提示词，说明父亲当时就像是‘博物馆’（museum）里的讲解员一样在给‘我’介绍工具。
questions.supplement:
A(playground)：语境句：The children are having fun in the playground. 固定搭配：school playground, outdoor playground
B(museum)：语境句：We visited the national museum to learn about history. 固定搭配：art museum, museum curator
C(studio)：语境句：The artist spends most of his time painting in his studio. 固定搭配：art studio, recording studio
D(workshop)：语境句：He makes beautiful furniture in his wooden workshop. 固定搭配：training workshop, attend a workshop

questions.explanation: 由后面的‘paying little attention to what he said’（很少注意听他说话）可知，‘我’当时并不是一个‘专注的’（attentive）倾听者。
questions.supplement:
A(attentive)：语境句：The students were very attentive during the fascinating lecture. 固定搭配：be attentive to, an attentive listener
B(sympathetic)：语境句：She was very sympathetic to the homeless man's situation. 固定搭配：be sympathetic to/towards, a sympathetic ear
C(efficient)：语境句：The new system is much more efficient than the old one. 固定搭配：efficient way, highly efficient
D(characteristic)：语境句：The spicy flavor is characteristic of local cuisine. 固定搭配：be characteristic of, characteristic feature

questions.explanation: ‘我’喜欢五金店是因为觉得‘好玩’（fun），比如觉得有些商品像科幻电影里的机器人手臂。这是小孩子典型的充满乐趣的视角。
questions.supplement:
A(big)：语境句：Buying a house is a big decision for most families. 固定搭配：big deal, big fan
B(fundamental)：语境句：Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right. 固定搭配：fundamental difference, fundamental principles
C(fun)：语境句：We had a fun time at the amusement park yesterday. 固定搭配：for fun, make fun of
D(practical)：语境句：She gave me some practical advice on how to save money. 固定搭配：practical experience, practical application

questions.explanation: 后文提到这位店主是和前任店主（他的父亲）一起在店里长大的，说明他从父亲手中‘接管’（took over）了这家店。
questions.supplement:
A(set up)：语境句：They plan to set up a new company next year. 固定搭配：set up a business, set up an organization
B(brought in)：语境句：The new policy brought in a lot of foreign investment. 固定搭配：bring in money, bring in experts
C(won back)：语境句：The team played hard and finally won back the championship. 固定搭配：win back trust, win back support
D(took over)：语境句：He took over the family business after his father retired. 固定搭配：take over control, take over a company

questions.explanation: 柜台处有狗，孩子们待得久的话可以‘抚摸’（pet）狗。pet作动词意为‘抚摸（动物）’，符合小孩子在商店里的行为。
questions.supplement:
A(walk)：语境句：He usually walks his dog in the park after dinner. 固定搭配：walk the dog, go for a walk
B(spot)：语境句：I managed to spot my friend in the crowded room. 固定搭配：spot a mistake, on the spot
C(pet)：语境句：The little girl gently petted the cat on the sofa. 固定搭配：pet a dog, pet a cat
D(train)：语境句：It takes patience to train a puppy properly. 固定搭配：train hard, train sb to do sth

questions.explanation: 店主在这家店里和父亲一起长大，现在又接手了这家店，所以他对这家店有很强的‘情感纽带/羁绊’（ties）。
questions.supplement:
A(partnerships)：语境句：The two companies formed strong partnerships to develop new technology. 固定搭配：in partnership with, build partnerships
B(ties)：语境句：The two countries have established strong economic ties. 固定搭配：family ties, emotional ties
C(interactions)：语境句：Social media has completely changed our daily interactions. 固定搭配：social interactions, human interactions
D(wills)：语境句：The lawyer helped him draft his last will before he passed away. 固定搭配：against one's will, strong will

questions.explanation: 破折号前是‘everything you need for your home’（家里需要的一切），即生活‘必需品’（necessities）。
questions.supplement:
A(alternatives)：语境句：We need to find renewable alternatives to fossil fuels. 固定搭配：have no alternative but to, alternative energy
B(extras)：语境句：The hotel charges for extras like room service and laundry. 固定搭配：optional extras, hidden extras
C(necessities)：语境句：Food, clothing, and shelter are basic human necessities. 固定搭配：daily necessities, absolute necessities
D(groceries)：语境句：She went to the supermarket to buy some groceries for the week. 固定搭配：buy groceries, grocery store

questions.explanation: 在去五金店的过程中，父亲把他生活‘世界’（world）的一个角落变成了作者自己的。五金店代表了父亲的世界。
questions.supplement:
A(leisure)：语境句：Reading is my favorite way to spend my leisure time. 固定搭配：at one's leisure, leisure time
B(dream)：语境句：It has always been her dream to travel around the world. 固定搭配：achieve a dream, sweet dreams
C(trip)：语境句：We are planning a road trip to the coast next month. 固定搭配：business trip, go on a trip
D(world)：语境句：Books can open up a whole new world for children. 固定搭配：around the world, one's own world

questions.explanation: 作者在结尾表达了回馈：下次见到父亲时，‘我’要‘陪’（accompany）他去五金店，就像小时候他带我一样。
questions.supplement:
A(accompany)：语境句：Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult. 固定搭配：accompany sb to a place, keep sb company
B(drive)：语境句：Could you drive me to the airport tomorrow morning? 固定搭配：drive sb crazy, drive to work
C(guide)：语境句：The tour guide will guide you through the ancient ruins. 固定搭配：guide sb through, tour guide
D(expose)：语境句：Parents shouldn't expose their children to violent movies. 固定搭配：expose sb to sth, be exposed to

vocab_pack.definition_en: recently, a short time ago
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 时间状语短语，在句中作状语，表示动作发生在不久之前。原文中首字母大写，置于句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: Not long ago, I finished reading that novel.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不久前，我读完了那本小说。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Not long ago, I took my mother to a hardware store.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to escort or bring someone to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时 took，主语 I，后接宾语 my mother，介词 to 连接地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will take my brother to the museum tomorrow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 明天我会带我弟弟去博物馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I took my mother to a hardware store.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在原文中为 didn't get it，一般过去时否定，get 为动词原形，it 指代前文内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: I didn't get the joke until she explained it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 直到她解释，我才明白那个笑话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my mother didn't get it.

vocab_pack.definition_en: something typical of or associated with fathers
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在句中作表语，说明 hardware store 是父亲们喜欢的事物。
vocab_pack.example_en: Grilling steak is a dad thing in our family.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在我们家，烤牛排是父亲的专属活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The hardware store is a dad thing .

vocab_pack.definition_en: to walk slowly around without a fixed purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 wandered，描述父亲在过道里来回走动的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He wandered around the park for an hour.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在公园里闲逛了一个小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my father wandered in the aisles

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow closely behind someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 tailing，作伴随状语，表示“我跟在他后面”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The detective was tailing the suspect through the crowd.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 侦探在人群中跟踪嫌疑人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with me tailing him

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to find something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 searched，后接宾语从句 what he needed。
vocab_pack.example_en: She searched for her keys everywhere this morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她今早到处找钥匙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He searched for what he needed

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pay no attention to; to disregard
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词 ignoring，作介词 while 的宾语，表示“不忽视我”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He continued reading while ignoring the noise outside.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他继续阅读，无视外面的噪音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while not ignoring me

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of forming a close relationship
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作 call it 的宾语，指代父子之间的亲密互动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The camping trip was great for family bonding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那次露营旅行对增进家庭感情很有好处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You could call it " bonding ".

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or draw attention to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语 to point out，作目的状语。原文中 would stop...to point out。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher pointed out the main grammar mistake in my essay.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师指出了我作文中的主要语法错误。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to point out garden tools

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel admiration or respect
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 给……留下深刻印象；使钦佩
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 might 后接动词原形 impress，宾语 me。
vocab_pack.example_en: His performance impressed the judges greatly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的表演给评委留下了深刻印象。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he thought might impress me

vocab_pack.definition_en: as if; in a way that suggests
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 引导方式状语从句，表示“好像……似的”。从句中用了 was（虚拟语气也可，但这里是陈述）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He looked at me as though he had never seen me before.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他看着我，好像从未见过我似的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as though the store was a kind of museum

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who guides visitors through a museum or gallery
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作表语，与 enthusiastic 搭配，指父亲像热情的导览员。
vocab_pack.example_en: The docent explained the history of each painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 讲解员解释了每幅画的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he was the enthusiastic docent

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who listens carefully and with interest
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作表语，前面有否定 wasn't a very，表示“不是一个非常专注的听众”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is an attentive listener in class and remembers details well.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在课堂上是个专注的听众，能记住很多细节。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I wasn't a very attentive listener

vocab_pack.definition_en: to not give much notice or interest to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语 paying little attention to，作伴随状语，表示“几乎不注意他说的话”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He paid little attention to the teacher's warning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他几乎没有在意老师的警告。
vocab_pack.from_passage: paying little attention to what he said

vocab_pack.definition_en: to resemble; to have a similar appearance to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 looked，后接名词短语 robot arms。
vocab_pack.example_en: That cloud looks like a rabbit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那朵云看起来像一只兔子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: like how some items looked like robot arms

vocab_pack.definition_en: a mechanical arm of a robot
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数 arms，在介词 like 后作宾语，表示像机器人的手臂。
vocab_pack.example_en: The factory uses robot arms to assemble cars.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工厂用机械臂组装汽车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: looked like robot arms

vocab_pack.definition_en: a science fiction movie
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 from 的宾语，表示“来自科幻电影”。
vocab_pack.example_en: I love watching sci-fi films with amazing special effects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢看特效震撼的科幻电影。
vocab_pack.from_passage: from a sci-fi film

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assume control or ownership of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 took，后接宾语 this store。
vocab_pack.example_en: He took over the family business after his father retired.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他父亲退休后他接手了家族生意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who took over this store

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter a place accompanied by someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时 come，主语 Fathers 复数，后接 with their kids。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students came in with their backpacks and sat down.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们背着书包进来坐下了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fathers come in with their kids all the time.

vocab_pack.definition_en: continuously; very often
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 时间状语短语，修饰动词 come in，表示“总是带孩子们进来”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She checks her phone all the time during class.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她上课时总是不停地看手机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fathers come in with their kids all the time.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stroke or touch an animal gently as a sign of affection
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形 pet，宾语 my dog。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can pet the cat if it comes near you.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果猫靠近你，你可以抚摸它。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They can pet my dog at the counter

vocab_pack.definition_en: near or at the front desk or service counter of a store
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 地点状语，表示“在柜台那里”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please wait at the counter for your order.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请在柜台处等待您的订单。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pet my dog at the counter

vocab_pack.definition_en: close connections or bonds between people or with a place
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 紧密的联系，深厚的情感纽带
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 feels 的宾语，表示“感觉与这家店有深厚的联系”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has strong ties with her hometown.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她和家乡有着深厚的感情联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Steve feels strong ties with the store

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spend one's childhood together with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 grew up，后接介词 with 短语，表示和父亲一起在店里长大。
vocab_pack.example_en: I grew up with my cousin next door.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我和隔壁的表哥一起长大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: where he grew up with the former owner — his father.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use or occupy one's time doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时 spends，主语 he 第三人称单数，his days 为宾语，on 介词引出具体内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: She spends her days on teaching and research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每天的时间都花在教学和研究上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Now he spends his days on "everything you need for your home"

vocab_pack.definition_en: in other words; used to introduce a clarification
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 插入语，用于解释前面 everything you need 的具体内容，相当于 i.e.。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is a botanist, that is, a plant scientist.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是一位植物学家，也就是研究植物的科学家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that is, the necessities .

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that is essential or needed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 necessities，在句中作 the 的同位语，表示这些就是必需品。
vocab_pack.example_en: Food and water are basic necessities for life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 食物和水是生活的基本必需品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the necessities .

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: made a corner of his world my own
vocab_pack.definition_en: to take possession of something or make it belong to oneself
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某物成为自己的一部分；把……变成自己的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 has made，宾语为 a corner of his world，宾补 my own。表示父亲把他世界的一角变成了“我”的。
vocab_pack.example_en: She made the old house her own by redecorating it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她通过重新装修把老房子变成了自己的风格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My father has made a corner of his world my own

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go somewhere with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般将来时 will accompany，后接宾语 him，介词 to 表示目的地。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will accompany you to the train station.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我会陪你去火车站。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'll accompany him to the hardware store.

section_2_word_form.passage:
The annual "Chinese Bridge" competition, often described as the "Olympics of Chinese", has attracted more than 1.7 million young language enthusiasts from around the world since its initiation in 2002, which not only develops friendships among participants, but also offers a platform [56] people's cultural exchange.
Participants explored China's beautiful landscapes and involved [57] in its rich culture. They managed to facilitate understanding and exchanges between each other, [58] diverse traditions' differences through Chinese culture and language.
Following several rounds of competitions, the event [59] by China's Ministry of Education and the Fujian provincial government, with an education institute organizing the final gathering of 147 competitors from 130 countries and regions, all of [60] were united by their passion for Chinese culture. The finals consisted of four rounds, showcasing [61] host of elements of Fujian's fu culture and maritime (海运的) history. Contestants from various continents presented performances that [62] combined their native cultural elements with traditional Chinese culture, giving audiences insights into the rich traditions.
One of the standout participants, Benjamin Herman, [63] the global champion from Belgium. "This competition has provided a good opportunity to learn from one another. I'm excited [64] and won first place, and will continue to work hard," Herman, who has studied Chinese for three years, said, expressing [65] in his achievement.

questions.explanation: 考查介词。offer a platform for sth 意为‘为...提供一个平台’，此处指为人们的文化交流提供平台。
questions.supplement: 正确形(for)：语境句：This program provides a stage for young talents to shine. 固定搭配：a platform for, provide sth for sb。

questions.explanation: 考查代词。主语是Participants，此处表示‘使他们自己参与到丰富的文化中’，involve oneself in 是固定搭配，故用反身代词 themselves。
questions.supplement: 正确形(themselves)：语境句：The students dedicated themselves to the volunteer work. 固定搭配：involve themselves in, enjoy themselves。原词they其它变形：their(adj.), theirs(pron.), them(pron.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句子主干完整，此处表示伴随或自然而然的结果，bridge（架起桥梁，弥合）与主语 They 之间是主动关系，故用现在分词 bridging。
questions.supplement: 正确形(bridging)：语境句：The program aims at bridging the gap between the rich and the poor. 固定搭配：bridge the gap, bridge differences。原词bridge其它变形：bridge(n. 桥梁)。

questions.explanation: 考查时态和语态。本句的主语是 the event，与 guide 之间是被动关系；根据前文的 explored, managed 等可知叙述的是已发生的事，故用一般过去时的被动语态 was guided。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was guided)：语境句：The entire project was guided by an experienced professor. 固定搭配：be guided by。原词guide其它变形：guidance(n.), guiding(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后是“介词 + 关系代词”引导的非限制性定语从句，先行词是 147 competitors（人），故介词 of 后用 whom。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whom)：语境句：He has three brothers, all of whom are doctors. 固定搭配：all of whom, some of whom。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。a host of 是固定短语，意为‘许多，大量’，修饰可数名词复数 elements。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：The decision caused a host of problems for the company. 固定搭配：a host of, a lot of。

questions.explanation: 考查副词。此处需要用副词来修饰动词 combined，able 的副词形式是 ably，意为‘巧妙地，能干地’。
questions.supplement: 正确形(ably)：语境句：She ably managed the crisis and saved the company from ruin. 固定搭配：ably assisted, ably managed。原词able其它变形：ability(n.), unable(adj.), enable(v.)。

questions.explanation: 考查谓语动词。主语是 One of the standout participants，核心词是 One，谓语动词用单数；描述比赛产生的结果，属于过去发生的事实，故用一般过去时 was。（填 is 表示现任身份也可接受，但通篇背景为过去时，was 更严谨）
questions.supplement: 正确形(was)：语境句：One of the main reasons for the failure was lack of communication. 固定搭配：was recognized as, was named as。原词be其它变形：is/am/are, been, being。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。be excited to do sth（对做某事感到兴奋）；由连词 and 后面的 won（过去式/过去分词）可知，come 的动作已经发生，需与 won 保持结构或逻辑上的对称（即 to have come and won），故用不定式的完成式 to have come。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to have come)：语境句：I am extremely lucky to have come across such a great mentor. 固定搭配：be excited to do, claim to have done。原词come其它变形：came(v.), coming(adj./v.)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词。express 是及物动词，后接名词作宾语，且固定搭配 express pride in / take pride in 意为‘对...感到自豪’，故填 proud 的名词形式 pride。
questions.supplement: 正确形(pride)：语境句：The parents took great pride in their daughter's academic success. 固定搭配：express pride in, take pride in, a sense of pride。原词proud其它变形：proudly(adv.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: occurring once every year
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作定语修饰名词competition，形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school holds an annual sports meeting to promote teamwork.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校每年举行一次运动会以促进团队合作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The annual "Chinese Bridge" competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say that someone or something has a particular quality or feature
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，be described as，此处described是过去分词，表示被描述为。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people describe the Grand Canyon as one of the natural wonders.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人将大峡谷描述为自然奇观之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: often described as the "Olympics of Chinese"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone or something to come to a place or event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，主语为competition，has + 过去分词attracted，表示已经吸引了。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exhibition aims to attract more visitors from abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次展览旨在吸引更多来自国外的参观者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has attracted more than 1.7 million young language enthusiasts

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is very interested in languages
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，在文中作宾语，指众多语言爱好者。
vocab_pack.example_en: As a language enthusiast, she enjoys learning different dialects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 作为一名语言爱好者，她喜欢学习不同的方言。
vocab_pack.from_passage: more than 1.7 million young language enthusiasts

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of starting something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词since的宾语，名词原形，表示启动时间点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The initiation of the project was marked by a grand ceremony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个项目的启动以一场盛大的仪式为标志。
vocab_pack.from_passage: since its initiation in 2002

vocab_pack.definition_en: to build and strengthen bonds of friendship
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语which（指competition）第三人称单数，develops加s；friendships为可数名词复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Exchange programs help students develop friendships across cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 交流项目帮助学生建立跨文化的友谊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not only develops friendships among participants

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide a means or opportunity for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语which第三人称单数，offers加s；a platform for是固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The conference offers a platform for young scientists to share their research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 会议为年轻科学家提供了一个分享研究成果的平台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: offers a platform for people's cultural exchange

vocab_pack.definition_en: the sharing of ideas, customs, and traditions between different cultures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词for的宾语，名词短语，通常不可数，此处表示泛指。
vocab_pack.example_en: Student exchange programs promote cultural exchange and mutual understanding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生交换项目促进文化交流和相互理解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: offers a platform for people's cultural exchange

vocab_pack.definition_en: to travel to or examine a place in order to learn about it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语participants为复数，谓语动词用过去式explored。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists explore the depths of the ocean to discover new species.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家探索海洋深处以发现新物种。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Participants explored China's beautiful landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in an activity or become part of it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语they（participants），谓语involved，反身代词themselves对应主语，后接介词in。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should involve themselves in community service to gain experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生应该参与社区服务以获得经验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: involved themselves in its rich culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make an action or process easier
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式to后接动词原形，原文managed to facilitate，故为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Modern technology can facilitate communication across long distances.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 现代技术可以促进远距离沟通。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They managed to facilitate understanding and exchanges

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce the differences between two things or groups
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式，作状语，表示通过中文和文化弥合差异；后面接宾语differences。
vocab_pack.example_en: Dialogue can bridge the gap between different generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对话可以弥合不同代际之间的鸿沟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: bridging diverse traditions' differences through Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be directed or influenced by someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，was guided by，过去分词guided表示被指导，by引出施动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Young people should be guided by experienced mentors in their career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 年轻人在职业生涯中应受有经验的导师指导。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the event was guided by China's Ministry of Education

vocab_pack.definition_en: the last meeting of a group of people for a specific purpose
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 最后一轮集会；最终聚会
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作organize的宾语，名词短语，修饰语final在前。
vocab_pack.example_en: The final gathering of the conference will feature keynote speeches.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 会议的最后聚会上将进行主题演讲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: organizing the final gathering of 147 competitors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be brought together by a common feeling or purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，were united by，过去分词united表示被联合，by引出共同因素。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team was united by a shared dream of winning the championship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个团队因共同赢得冠军的梦想而团结在一起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: all of whom were united by their passion for Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong feeling of enthusiasm or love for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词passion后接介词for，构成搭配，在文中作介词by的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her passion for art inspired her to become a painter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对艺术的热情激励她成为一名画家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: united by their passion for Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be composed or made up of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语finals为复数，谓语用过去式consisted，后接of。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exam consists of four parts: listening, reading, writing, and speaking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考试由四个部分组成：听力、阅读、写作和口语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The finals consisted of four rounds

vocab_pack.definition_en: to display or present something in an attractive way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式，作状语，补充说明finals的结果，表示展示。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exhibition showcases the latest achievements in technology.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 展览展示了最新的技术成就。
vocab_pack.from_passage: showcasing a host of elements of Fujian's fu culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large number of; many
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，修饰可数名词elements，表示大量。
vocab_pack.example_en: A host of volunteers participated in the charity event.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多志愿者参加了这次慈善活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: showcasing a host of elements

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to the sea or ships
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作定语修饰名词history，形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The maritime industry plays a vital role in global trade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 海运业在全球贸易中扮演着至关重要的角色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Fujian's fu culture and maritime history

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a skillful and effective way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰动词combined，表示表演巧妙地结合了元素。
vocab_pack.example_en: She ably managed the team to complete the project on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她巧妙地管理团队，按时完成了项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented performances that ably combined

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join or mix two or more things together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，定语从句中谓语动词用过去式combined，后接with介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe combines traditional flavors with modern cooking techniques.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱将传统风味与现代烹饪技术相结合。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ably combined their native cultural elements with traditional Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: a deep understanding of a particular subject or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作动词giving的直接宾语，insights为复数，后接介词into。
vocab_pack.example_en: The documentary provides valuable insights into wildlife conservation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部纪录片提供了对野生动物保护的宝贵见解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: giving audiences insights into the rich traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large number of cultural customs and practices passed down over time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，作介词into的宾语，表示多种丰富传统。
vocab_pack.example_en: The festival celebrates the rich tradition of Chinese folk art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日庆祝中国民间艺术的丰富传统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: insights into the rich traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: noticeably better or more impressive than others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作定语修饰名词participants，形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was the standout performer in the competition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是比赛中表现最突出的选手。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One of the standout participants

vocab_pack.definition_en: the person who wins the first place in a worldwide competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作表语，名词短语，global为形容词修饰champion。
vocab_pack.example_en: She became the global champion after defeating all opponents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在击败所有对手后成为了全球冠军。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Benjamin Herman, was the global champion from Belgium

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make it possible for someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，谓语provided，后接名词短语a good opportunity，再跟不定式to学习。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scholarship provides an opportunity to study abroad for two years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 奖学金提供了出国留学两年的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provided a good opportunity to learn from one another

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain knowledge or skills by mutual interaction
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式to后接动词原形learn，from one another是固定短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: In group activities, students can learn from one another.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在小组活动中，学生们可以互相学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a good opportunity to learn from one another

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something that will happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词excited后接不定式to，在文中为I'm excited to，表示主语的情绪。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is excited to start her new job next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对下个月开始新工作感到兴奋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'm excited to have come and won first place

vocab_pack.definition_en: to achieve the highest position in a competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，与have构成现在完成时have won，表示已经赢得第一名。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team worked hard to win first place in the final.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队努力拼搏，在决赛中获得了第一名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: won first place

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or state that one feels proud of someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式，作状语，表示伴随动作；pride后接介词in。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher expressed pride in her students' achievements.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师对学生们的成就表示自豪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: expressing pride in his achievement
